## What changes and why

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks actually run and results. Mention untested platforms or provider integrations.

## Review

- [ ] Focused regression tests for changed behavior; no live accounts or paid services used.
- [ ] Documentation and dependency lockfiles updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or generated installers included.
- [ ] New assets include sources, licenses and attribution.
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance disclosed, and the full diff reviewed by the contributor.
